patterns.note: A prominent, full-bleed hero section features oversized, partially visible typographic elements that interact dynamically with the background image on scroll.
Content sections below the hero are primarily structured in a two-column card grid, featuring images and concise text summaries for articles and events.
Extreme contrast in type scale is used, with massive, bold sans-serif for the hero's branding overlay and a more restrained, legible sans-serif for all body and heading text.
A clean, high-contrast palette of white and black is accented by a vibrant, institutional red used for navigation highlights, call-to-action buttons, and the footer.

The hero features a sophisticated parallax effect where a large, fixed-position text overlay ('SFMOMA') remains static while a dynamic, full-bleed background image scrolls and subtly changes beneath it, creating a sense of depth and movement.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a WebGL/Three.js driven animation where a large, fixed typographic element is overlaid on a dynamic background image or 3D scene that scrolls at a different rate, creating a deep parallax effect and an immersive visual experience. Subsequent content sections simply scroll into view without additional animation.
Content cards utilize a simple image-on-top, text-below structure, with clear headings and short descriptive paragraphs, maintaining a consistent visual hierarchy across various content types.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy display text (~8x body) for the hero branding, contrasted with a balanced sans-serif for headings (~2-3x body) and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements, images, and content cards, contributing to a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density for content sections with clear vertical rhythm, while the hero section feels very airy due to the large scale of its elements and dynamic background.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the hero's dynamic, large-scale typographic overlay that interacts with a WebGL-driven background image. This creates a highly immersive and memorable first impression, elevating the museum's brand beyond a static image and drawing the user into the experience.
